issues.display_title: Issue #16: [Place Detail] Implement Place Detail Page
issues.main_description_html:
Migrate Place Detail (RN → Flutter)

Source of truth: RN panorra, src/pages/place-detail (no -old folders)
Spec: docs/place-detail-flutter-prd.md
Branch: feat/place-detail

Scope

  • API: /places/detail/{slug} plus the posts, contributors and bookmarks lists (paginated), with mappers that match src/api
  • Riverpod PlaceStore: detail, per-tab pagination, lazy-loaded tabs, and preview-cover handling
  • Page UI:
    • back bar, hero (Fraunces font), info row with share, and stats
    • sticky tab bar for Posts, Contributors and Bookmarks
    • rows for each tab, plus skeleton, error/retry and empty states, and load-more
  • Follow/unfollow for contributors (optimistic update; viewers are sent to Login)
  • Share place (share_plus; iOS shares the URL only)
  • Route /place/:slug plus the Home modal host (92% sheet; close, then navigate after 300 ms)
  • Unit tests for share, mappers, format and store
  • flutter analyze clean

Known deviations

  • Font Awesome Free icons stand in for Pro.
  • Image.network is used instead of cached_network_image.
  • Follow does not yet send analytics or push notifications, or update the profile following count (those modules are not migrated yet).
  • Post Detail and Public Profile are still placeholder routes.

Progress update: Place Detail migration (FE), done

Branch: feat/place-detail (pushed, no PR yet)
Commit: 34e6e47 feat: migrate Place Detail page. feat/home-migration has also been merged into this branch.
Source of truth: RN panorra, src/pages/place-detail. Flow, UI/UX, colors and copy are ported 1:1; only the libraries change.
Spec: docs/place-detail-flutter-prd.md
Status: flutter analyze is clean. All 99 tests pass, 18 of them new in test/place_detail_test.dart.

1. API and data

  • PlacesApi gains four fetchers:
    • fetchPlaceDetail: /places/detail/{slug}
    • fetchPlacePosts: sort: latest_post, 20 per page
    • fetchPlaceContributors: 30 per page
    • fetchPlaceBookmarks: sends location_name, 20 per page
  • The mappers match RN src/api:
    • post and place location-label fallbacks
    • embed-type badge (villume / tourmkr / gvt)
    • contributor rank and top creator
    • bookmark folder id falls back to the slug
  • ConnectionsApi.toggleFollow: follow/unfollow, the upload subscription sync, and the cache flushes.
  • getApiErrorMessage helper.

2. State: PlaceStore (Riverpod, family by slug)

  • Detail and posts load in parallel on open.
  • The preview passed from Home renders immediately, and its panorama cover is kept after the detail response arrives.
  • Per-tab pagination with an in-flight guard for load-more.
  • Tabs load lazily: contributors on first open, bookmarks only once the place name is known.
  • setContributorFollowing keeps the follow state in sync after a toggle.

3. UI (lib/pages/place_detail/)

  • Header:
    • back bar
    • hero, 180 px cover with gradient and Fraunces title
    • info row with the share pill
    • stats card (posts / views)
  • Sticky tab bar: Posts, Contributors and Bookmarks (SliverPersistentHeader).
  • Rows:
    • post row: thumbnail, post-type badge, mention-stripped title, metrics, author avatar
    • contributor row: top-creator tag and Follow / Following button
    • bookmark folder row
  • States: skeletons, error with "Try again", empty states, and infinite scroll at 30% from the end. The list scrolls back to the top on tab change.
  • Share: share_plus. iOS shares the bare URL; Android shares the title, location and URL (panorra.com / dev.panorra.com).
  • Follow: optimistic update with rollback and an alert on failure. The button is hidden on the user's own row, and viewers are sent to Login.
  • Shared components added:
    • AppButton (outline/ghost)
    • AppAvatar
    • PostTypeBadge
    • stripMentionMarkup
    • globalFollowProvider

4. Navigation

  • New route /place/:slug (PlaceDetailScreen). An optional PlaceDetailUi preview can be passed via extra, and an empty slug shows "Place not found."
  • Home modal host: the placeholder preview is replaced by the real PlaceDetail.
    • The sheet takes 92% of the height and has a drag handle.
    • Back closes the sheet.
    • Tapping a post or profile closes the sheet, then navigates after 300 ms, as in RN.

5. Tests: test/place_detail_test.dart

  • share URL and payload (5 cases)
  • mappers, including the location fallbacks
  • formatPlaceMetric, formatPlaceStatCount, initialOf
  • stripMentionMarkup
  • PlaceStore: preview cover is kept, pagination stops at the total, bookmarks load lazily

Known deviations / follow-ups

  • Font Awesome Free icons stand in for Pro. For example, the "multiple" post badge uses solidClone.
  • Image.network is used instead of cached_network_image, which is not in the approved package list.
  • Follow side effects are not ported yet: analytics, push notification, and the profile following count. Those modules are not migrated.
  • The share pill has no extended hitSlop equivalent.
  • The Home sheet has a single fixed 92% height (no DraggableScrollableSheet), so it cannot be dragged to resize.
  • Post Detail (#8) and Public Profile are still placeholder routes. The navigation params are already passed via extra.
  • RN behavior kept on purpose (open questions in the PRD):
    • bookmark folders are not tappable
    • the contributor skeleton avatar is 80 px while the real avatar is 48 px
    • contributor rank relies on the backend top_rank
  • Not yet verified on a physical device.

2. Bottom tab bar and create-post sheet — 1f671b9

3. Supporting work already on this branch

  • Login — 554abe2:
    • Email/password login, Google and Apple sign-in, and the OTP redirect for unverified accounts.
    • Session storage, i18n with all 15 languages from RN, environment config, and the app icons.
  • 360° viewer — 66d86da:
    • Local panorama_viewer package using a GLSL fragment shader, with a WebView fallback.
    • Panorama demo page.
    • Tests for the camera and the projection.
  • Onboarding — c5baef7:
    • Three parallax slides, progress dots, gradient CTA, a fading Skip button and the login link.
    • The onboarding flag uses the same storage keys and version as RN.

4. App shell — docs/app-shell-flutter-prd.md

Phase Commit Scope Status
P1 — Crash safety & splash 04bcdc1 Native splash (flutter_native_splash) held until bootstrap resolves; global error handlers; startup error screen; per-step timeouts plus a 20 s watchdog ✅ Done
P2 — Theme b233ac2 themeProvider (hydrate before persist); default follows the OS (also on resume); themeMode derived from the label; status bar follows the theme ✅ Done
P3 — Session & initial route 4b706d9 SessionController (initEnv / getProfile / loginViewer / seedSession); viewer retry on foreground; initial-route matrix (Onboarding / Login / Main); onboarding storage ✅ Done (wakelock skipped)
P4 — Shell overlays e36b690 UiStore (loading / alert / photo); alert toast with the bookmark "See" action; loading overlay with Cancel; image view; maintenance screen plus health check (on mount and every 60 s); connectivity via connectivity_plus (offline alert after 2 s, hidden on reconnect) ✅ Done
P5 — Notifications & version — FCM plus local notifications, NotifRouter, checkVersion ⏸️ Deferred
P6 — Router skeleton — Register all 91 RN MainStack routes (17 exist now); stack transitions (FR-S4); Android back closes the sheet first (FR-S5) ⏸️ Deferred

Tests: app_shell_test, app_shell_widget_test, theme_controller_test, session_bootstrap_test, onboarding_page_test and app_shell_overlays_test.

5. Not 1:1 with RN (documented decisions)

Item RN Flutter Reason
Slow-connection alert NetInfo cellular generation / isConnectionExpensive Not ported connectivity_plus exposes neither value
Offline alert icon FA Pro wifi-slash Material wifi_off_rounded, same 16 px size FA Free has no wifi-slash
Loading spinner ActivityIndicator size="large" CircularProgressIndicator.adaptive, 36 px Closest native equivalent
Bookmark "See" action navigates to Bookmark Pushes a /bookmark placeholder with the folder passed as extra Bookmark screen is not ported yet
Global keep-awake activateKeepAwakeAsync('global-app') Skipped Pending PRD Q2
iOS status bar re-apply after 150 ms workaround Not ported AnnotatedRegion re-applies it automatically
Onboarding dots hitSlop hitSlop Dropped No direct Flutter equivalent

6. Outstanding / blockers

  • Device location: not migrated yet (no location package added). Recenter currently shows RN's "We could not get your location" alert.
  • Place Detail screen: not migrated yet; the modal shows the preview body only.
  • Home mount side effects (PRD §5.6):
    • Centrifugo token: not ported yet.
    • Push registration and notification tap navigation: depend on P5.
  • Bottom nav: the notification badge and the POTD state are not ported yet (their stores and APIs are not migrated).
  • P5 needs decisions before work starts:
    1. New packages: firebase_core and package_info_plus are not in the approved library mapping and need approval.
    2. Push tokens (needs BE input): RN registers Expo push tokens (getExpoPushTokenAsync) and BE sends through Expo Push. A Flutter app can only provide a raw FCM/APNs token, so pushes from BE will not reach it until BE supports FCM tokens.
    3. App version: pubspec.yaml is 1.0.0+1 while RN is 1.9.46 (versionCode 176). checkVersion compares the build number against version_code from the API, so the version must be aligned or the update badge will always show.
  • Flagged/hidden in RN: showSheetSearch, showSortRow and quickFilters keep their logic ported; the UI is deferred, same as in RN.
  • Manual QA still needed (PRD acceptance checklist), on real iOS and Android devices:
    • Airplane mode: the offline alert, and the initial route.
    • Status bar readability in light and dark.
    • Theme persisting across restarts.

Frontend (FE) Integration Guide

Summary for Frontend Developers

Previously, the frontend had to manually persist Keycloak's refresh_token in localStorage and send it back in the request body upon logout.
With this update:

  1. On Login: The frontend passes refresh_token along with access_token to POST /auth/keycloak.
  2. After Login: The frontend no longer needs to persist kc_refresh_token separately in localStorage. Only the standard Panorra JWT token needs to be stored.
  3. On Logout: The frontend simply calls POST /auth/logout with Authorization: Bearer <panorra_token> and an empty body {}. The backend automatically extracts the refresh token from the JWT and terminates the Keycloak SSO session.

1. Update on Login Endpoint (POST /auth/keycloak)

Include the refresh_token received from the Keycloak SDK / token response:

// Example when logging in with keycloak-js
const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE_URL}/auth/keycloak`, {
  method: 'POST',
  headers: {
    'Content-Type': 'application/json',
  },
  body: JSON.stringify({
    access_token: keycloak.token,
    refresh_token: keycloak.refreshToken, // <-- ADD THIS
  }),
});

const result = await response.json();
if (result.statusCode === 200) {
  // Store Panorra token as usual
  localStorage.setItem('panorra_token', result.data.token);

  // NO LONGER NEEDED:
  // localStorage.setItem('kc_refresh_token', ...);
}

2. Update on Logout Endpoint (POST /auth/logout)

When logging out, the frontend no longer needs to retrieve or send refresh_token in the body:

// Simplified Frontend logout function
export async function logout(): Promise<void> {
  const panorraToken = localStorage.getItem('panorra_token');

  try {
    // Simply call POST /auth/logout with the Authorization header
    await fetch(`${API_BASE_URL}/auth/logout`, {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: {
        'Content-Type': 'application/json',
        ...(panorraToken ? { 'Authorization': `Bearer ${panorraToken}` } : {}),
      },
      body: JSON.stringify({}), // Empty body: backend automatically extracts refresh_token from JWT
    });
  } catch (error) {
    console.warn('Backend logout failed, continuing with local cleanup:', error);
  } finally {
    // Clear local storage
    localStorage.removeItem('panorra_token');
    sessionStorage.clear();

    // Redirect to login page
    window.location.href = '/login';
  }
}

Backward Compatibility Note: If an existing frontend client still sends { "refresh_token": "..." } in the body or query parameter, the backend still supports it seamlessly (100% backward compatible).

4. Frontend Integration Guide & Contract

Endpoint

Headers

Header Value Required Description
Authorization Bearer <JWT_TOKEN> Optional Authenticated session (supports viewer role)
ec "true" or "false" Optional Toggle AES-CBC response encryption

Query Parameters

Parameter Type Required Default Description
page integer No 1 Page number
limit integer No 10 Number of items per page
search string No - Search place or city name (e.g. Bogor, Subang, Gunung Pancar)
order string No newest Sort order: newest (by created_at) or nearest (by distance)
lat number Wajib jika order=nearest - User latitude (-90 to 90)
lng number Wajib jika order=nearest - User longitude (-180 to 180)
radius number No - Max radius filter in kilometers (optional)

curl -X GET "https://api.panorra.com/posts/trails?page=1&limit=10"

Frontend Integration Guide

1. Endpoints

2. Response Types (TypeScript)

export interface TrailPointDetail {
  sequence: number;    // 1..n (route order)
  name: string;        // E.g. "Trailhead / Start Point"
  url: string;         // E.g. "https://tourmkr.com/F1a1b2c3"
  tour_key: string;    // Parsed tour key, e.g. "a1b2c3"
  lat: number;         // Decimal latitude
  lng: number;         // Decimal longitude
  height_m: number;    // Elevation in meters
  distance_km: number; // Cumulative route distance from start (km)
  thumbnail: string;   // Image preview URL
}

export interface TrailDetail {
  difficulty: 'easy' | 'medium' | 'hard' | 'expert';
  activity_type: 'hiking' | 'trail-running' | 'mountain-biking' | 'walking' | 'off-road';
  total_distance_km: number;
  elevation_gain_m: number;
  elevation_loss_m: number;
  elevation_min_m: number;
  elevation_max_m: number;
  points: TrailPointDetail[];
}

export interface PostDetailResponse {
  statusCode: 200;
  data: {
    valid: true;
    messages: string;
    posts: {
      slug: string;
      post_type: 'trail' | 'tourmkr' | 'gvt' | 'villume' | 'panorama';
      location_name: string;
      description: string;
      thumbnail: string;
      panorama: string;
      trail: TrailDetail | null; // null if not a trail post
      // ...other standard post fields
    };
  };
}

Frontend Integration Guide

Endpoint

GET /gothru/virtual-tours

Headers

Header Value Description
Authorization Bearer <JWT_TOKEN> Required
Accept application/json Required

Query Parameters

Parameter Type Required Default Description
search string No "" Search by tour_name or tour_key. Pass {tour_key} to verify a pasted link.
page integer No 1 Page number (min: 1)
per_page integer No 20 Items per page (min: 1, max: 100)
foverlay_active string No - Comma-separated list of active states for hosted tours. Valid: 0,1,2,3. E.g. 1,3
goverlay_active string No - Comma-separated list of active states for Google tours. Valid: 0,1,2,3. E.g. 0,2

Response Model (TypeScript)

export interface VirtualTourItem {
